description: This Java source file defines the CsrfDefenseStrategy class, which implements CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) defense strategies for web security within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for generating tokens, handling CSRF checks, and managing token persistence.

classes.name: CsrfDefenseStrategy
classes.description: Implements CSRF defense mechanisms including token generation, request validation, and response handling within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a secure random CSRF token composed of alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: maxSubFolderInRequestUrlForTokenMapLookup
methods.description: Returns the request limit for token map lookup if the URI starts with 'entity/', otherwise returns 0.

methods.name: modifySecurityCsrfToken
methods.description: Determines whether the CSRF token should be modified based on the request URI and token value.

methods.name: keepTokenAfterUse
methods.description: Indicates whether to retain the CSRF token after a request, allowing back and forth navigation for GET requests.

methods.name: invalidTokenResponse
methods.description: Handles invalid or missing CSRF tokens by setting an error message and throwing an exception.
